name: Kettlebell Swing
cues: Hike the bell back between your thighs, behind your knees
Snap your hips forward so the bell floats up to chest height
Let your arms stay loose and guide the bell instead of lifting it
Stand tall with glutes tight at the top, then hinge as it falls
